Nadia (People Ops): Quick thread 124 review cycle logistics: timezone coverage, final deadlines, and a fast FAQ for managers. Please read if you own reviews.
Alex (Eng Manager): Thanks. Biggest headache = APAC overlap. Can we set a rolling calibration window instead of a single week?
Nadia (People Ops): We considered that. Final plan: central calibration week Mon 05/06 - Fri 05/10 ET/US overlap. For APAC-heavy teams you may request an async packet + an "APAC summary" slot the following Monday 05/13. Submit requests by 05/03.
Priya (HRBP): What exactly does an "APAC summary" need to include to count as valid async calibration?
Nadia (People Ops): Requirements: complete rubric entries, manager 1-2 sentence calibration rationale for each adjusted score, evidence binder (top 3 artifacts) uploaded, and an "APAC summary" doc listing any timezone-specific context or translations.
Hiro (EM): And for parents on leave who return mid-cycle? Do we still evaluate full period?
Samira (People Ops): Evaluate only the active days. Managers must include "% period active" in the context blurb. If performance cannot be judged fairly, use the exception form to mark "limited review".
Alex (Eng Manager): Contractors who converted last week 124 cutoff was 04/02. Do converted contractors make this cycle?
Nadia (People Ops): Convert cutoff = 04/02. Converted on or before that date are in scope. Later converts default to next cycle unless exception submitted.
hr-bot: Reminder: self-assessments due 05/01 23:59 ET. Link: https://redwood.company/hr/self-assess
Priya (HRBP): Training: can we run a 25-min rubric clinic for new managers? Some of our new hires are first-time managers.
Samira (People Ops): Yes 124 schedule: Rubric clinics Tue 05/07 08:30 PT and Wed 05/08 16:00 PT. Attend one. We'll record and post summary notes.
Alex (Eng Manager): How strict are packet upload rules? My lead likes to tinker until last minute.
Nadia (People Ops): Packet upload hard deadline: Fri 05/03 17:00 PT for inclusion in the calibration packet. We run a preflight on Mon 05/06 morning and will ping missing items. Late uploads may be excluded from exec packet.
Hiro (EM): If a manager is OOO during calibration, can a delegated reviewer submit? What level required?
Samira (People Ops): Yes. Delegates must be L4+ and include a short attestation line: "I reviewed evidence and endorse the manager's assessment." Mark "reviewer substitution" in the packet header.
Priya (HRBP): Any updates to appeals or retro windows this cycle?
Nadia (People Ops): Payroll cutoff for retro changes = Fri 05/24 17:00 ET. Appeals after that are allowed but will apply to next payroll cycle. Appeal flow: employee -> manager -> HRBP -> review panel.
Alex (Eng Manager): Can you paste the short exception template we should use in tickets?
Nadia (People Ops): Pasting template below (copy into exception form/ticket):
```
Employee: full name + role
Exception reason: (leave, late joiner, conversion, PIP)
Dates: start - end
Manager attestation: 1-2 sentence justification
Suggested path: exclude / limited review / include
Attachments: links to evidence
```
Samira (People Ops): We'll also publish a 1-pager FAQ and a quick checklist for ICs to improve self-assessments.
hr-bot: Exception form: https://redwood.company/hr/exceptions. Confirmation IDs auto-generated.
Alex (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll push this in team leads sync and confirm any APAC async requests by 05/03.
Nadia (People Ops): Appreciated. If anyone wants a sample completed packet or an anonymized binder, DM me and we'll share a redacted example. Final note: escalate critical payroll-impact cases to vp-people and comp-ops early.
